ticks.note: Not pressed. `pre(button)` is false in tick 1 (the default).
Pressed now, not pressed before: a rising edge, so `pressed` is true for this tick.
Still held: `button` and `pre(button)` are both true, so no edge.
Released now, pressed before: a falling edge, `released` is true.
Not pressed, and not pressed before: nothing.
A one-tick press gives a rising edge and, one tick later, a falling edge.
